Type_I.name: Type I
Type_I.description: Type I superstring theory includes both open and closed, unoriented strings. It exhibits N=1 supersymmetry in 10 dimensions, with 16 supercharges. An anomaly cancellation mechanism forces its gauge group to be SO(32). It is dual to the Heterotic SO(32) theory under S-duality.

massless_spectrum.name: Ramond-Ramond 2-form
massless_spectrum.description: Couples to D1 and D5 branes

massless_spectrum.name: SO(32) Gauge Bosons
massless_spectrum.description: Gauge fields for SO(32) Yang-Mills theory

massless_spectrum.name: SO(32) Gaugino
massless_spectrum.description: Supersymmetric partners of the gauge bosons

allowed_branes.name: D1-brane (D-string)
allowed_branes.description: Stable open-string bound state, dual to F1

allowed_branes.name: D5-brane
allowed_branes.description: Five-dimensional brane, couples magnetically to C_2

allowed_branes.name: D9-brane
allowed_branes.description: Spacetime-filling brane, required for anomaly cancellation and SO(32) gauge group

dualities.physical_effect: Maps strong coupling of Type I to weak coupling of Heterotic SO(32).

Type_IIA.name: Type IIA
Type_IIA.description: Type IIA superstring theory consists of oriented, closed strings. It has N=2 supersymmetry, which is non-chiral (meaning left- and right-movers have opposite chiralities). It is equivalent to 11D M-Theory compactified on a circle, where D0-branes represent Kaluza-Klein momentum states. It is T-dual to Type IIB.

massless_spectrum.name: Kalb-Ramond 2-form
massless_spectrum.description: Kalb-Ramond field, couples to fundamental strings (F1)

allowed_branes.name: D0-brane
allowed_branes.description: Point-like D-brane, represents Kaluza-Klein momentum of 11D gravity

allowed_branes.name: D4-brane
allowed_branes.description: Four-dimensional membrane, wrapping M5-brane on S1

allowed_branes.name: D8-brane
allowed_branes.description: Eight-dimensional membrane, acts as a domain wall in massive IIA supergravity

allowed_branes.name: NS5-brane
allowed_branes.description: Solitonic 5-brane, extremely heavy at weak coupling due to 1/g_s^2 scaling

dualities.physical_effect: Type IIA compactified on a circle of radius R is physically equivalent to Type IIB compactified on a circle of radius alpha'/R.
At strong coupling (g_s -> infinity), Type IIA grows an 11th dimension of radius R_11, becoming 11D M-Theory.

Type_IIB.name: Type IIB
Type_IIB.description: Type IIB superstring theory consists of oriented, closed strings. It has N=2 supersymmetry, which is chiral (meaning left- and right-movers have the same chirality). It is exceptionally symmetric, possessing a non-perturbative SL(2, Z) S-duality symmetry that maps the theory to itself, exchanging the fundamental string (F1) and the D-string (D1).

massless_spectrum.name: Kalb-Ramond 2-form
massless_spectrum.description: Kalb-Ramond field, couples to fundamental strings

massless_spectrum.name: Ramond-Ramond 4-form
massless_spectrum.description: Has a self-dual 5-form field strength F_5^+, couples to D3-branes

massless_spectrum.name: Gravitinos (Same Chirality)
massless_spectrum.description: Two gravitinos of the same chirality

massless_spectrum.name: Dilatinos (Same Chirality)
massless_spectrum.description: Two dilatinos of the same chirality

allowed_branes.name: D1-brane (D-string)
allowed_branes.description: Stable string-like brane, S-dual to F1

allowed_branes.name: D3-brane
allowed_branes.description: Three-dimensional brane, invariant under S-duality, hosts 4D N=4 Super Yang-Mills on its worldvolume

allowed_branes.name: D7-brane
allowed_branes.description: Seven-dimensional D-brane, codimension-2 object, essential in F-theory

allowed_branes.name: D9-brane
allowed_branes.description: Spacetime-filling D-brane, unstable unless coupled with orientifold planes

dualities.physical_effect: Type IIB compactified on a circle of radius R is T-dual to Type IIA compactified on a circle of radius alpha'/R.
Self-duality! Maps strong coupling to weak coupling, exchanging fundamental and D-type strings/5-branes while leaving the D3-brane invariant.

Heterotic_SO32.name: Heterotic SO(32)
Heterotic_SO32.description: Heterotic SO(32) theory utilizes a highly unique closed-string structure: left-moving modes are bosonic strings in 26 dimensions (with 16 compactified dimensions providing the SO(32) gauge group symmetries), while right-moving modes are 10D superstrings. It is chiral, has N=1 supersymmetry in 10D, and is T-dual to the Heterotic E8 x E8 theory.

massless_spectrum.name: Kalb-Ramond 2-form
massless_spectrum.description: Kalb-Ramond field, couples to heterotic string

massless_spectrum.name: SO(32) Gauge Bosons
massless_spectrum.description: Gauge fields for SO(32) Yang-Mills theory

massless_spectrum.name: SO(32) Gaugino
massless_spectrum.description: Supersymmetric partners of the gauge bosons

allowed_branes.name: NS5-brane
allowed_branes.description: Solitonic 5-brane, stable due to magnetic Kalb-Ramond charge. No stable D-branes exist in Heterotic theory.

dualities.physical_effect: Heterotic SO(32) compactified on a circle of radius R is dual to Heterotic E8xE8 compactified on a circle of radius alpha'/R.
Strong coupling Heterotic SO(32) maps to weakly coupled Type I superstring theory.

Heterotic_E8xE8.name: Heterotic E8 x E8
Heterotic_E8xE8.description: Heterotic E8 x E8 is the second heterotic theory. It utilizes the same structure as HO (left-moving 26D bosonic modes, right-moving 10D superstring modes), but the 16 compact left-moving dimensions are configured to produce E8 x E8 gauge symmetry. This theory is highly favored for phenomenology, since compactifying E8 x E8 on a Calabi-Yau manifold naturally yields grand unified models like E6, complete with three generations of fermions. It is dual to M-Theory on an interval under strong coupling.

massless_spectrum.name: Kalb-Ramond 2-form
massless_spectrum.description: Kalb-Ramond field, couples to heterotic string

massless_spectrum.name: E8 x E8 Gauge Bosons
massless_spectrum.description: Gauge fields for E8 x E8 Yang-Mills theory

massless_spectrum.name: E8 x E8 Gaugino
massless_spectrum.description: Supersymmetric partners of the gauge bosons

dualities.physical_effect: Heterotic E8xE8 compactified on a circle of radius R is T-dual to Heterotic SO(32) on a circle of radius alpha'/R.

At strong coupling, Heterotic E8xE8 grows an 11th dimension in the form of a line segment S1/Z2 (an interval). The two E8 gauge groups live on the two 9D boundary faces, realizing Horava-Witten theory.

M_Theory.name: M-Theory
M_Theory.description: M-Theory is the overarching 11-dimensional theory that unites all five superstring theories. Instead of strings, its fundamental excitations are 2-dimensional membranes (M2-branes) and 5-dimensional membranes (M5-branes). Superstring theories emerge as different limits of M-Theory (e.g., Type IIA is M-Theory compactified on a circle, Heterotic E8xE8 is M-Theory compactified on an interval S1/Z2).

massless_spectrum.name: 11D 3-form field
massless_spectrum.description: Three-form gauge potential, couples to M2-branes

allowed_branes.name: M2-brane
allowed_branes.description: Two-dimensional membrane, fundamental excitation of M-theory

allowed_branes.name: M5-brane
allowed_branes.description: Five-dimensional membrane, magnetic dual to M2-brane
